name: severance-broker
description: Vendor-adversarial procurement. Shops live VPS pricing, scores plans against hard rupee/region/spec constraints in code, and returns ranked VPS suggestions with pricing-page links. It cannot buy or provision. A signed cart mandate is attached for a later purchase agent.

skills.name: Shop and score providers
skills.description: Discover current pricing pages, scrape structured plan rows, and rank them against a Surveyor capacity spec. The ceiling, region allowlist, and spec floor are enforced in Python, not in the prompt.
examples: Shop a capacity spec with ceiling ₹1500
Score these VPS plans against the spec floor

skills.name: Mint signed cart mandate
skills.description: Re-check every constraint independently of scoring, then HMAC-SHA256 sign a severance.cart_mandate/v1. Refuses over-ceiling winners instead of minting.
examples: Mint a cart mandate for the winning Hetzner plan

skills.name: Human approval gate
skills.description: Park the A2A task in input-required with a deterministic purchase-order card. Resume only when the same session replies APPROVE <mandate_id>. Bare yes does not count.
